messages.content: You are an expert AI classifying 3D scene segments and predicting materials. You meticulously analyze images and format responses exactly as specified.

content.text:
This image shows a 3D model with color-coded segments in the viewport on the left. The right side has a legend mapping each color to its ID. The 6 segments are: ID 0 (shown in red, RGB=216,38,38); ID 1 (shown in green, RGB=48,232,101); ID 2 (shown in purple, RGB=168,61,244); ID 3 (shown in gold/yellow, RGB=228,212,103); ID 4 (shown in sky blue, RGB=25,195,229); ID 5 (shown in hot pink, RGB=243,36,148).

Task: For EACH segment (in the exact same order, returning exactly 6 results), predict a descriptive functional name and physical material.
Instructions:
- Analyze the image very carefully. Focus specifically on the relationship between the colors and the structural objects they highlight.
- Output your response ONLY as a clear JSON array with no formatting blocks.
Format constraint: [{"id": <integer>, "new_name": "...", "material": "..."}, ...].
